children: J.P. Morgan is forecasting the S&P 500
will end 2027 at 8,200, which would mean an increase of about 14% from the benchmark index's current level.
The bank expects "above-trend earnings growth... tied to the AI supercycle," according to a note Tuesday from Dubravko Lakos-Bujas, J.P. Morgan head of global markets strategy, and other strategists.

"In our view, the recent momentum unwind and broader positioning reset have improved the near term risk reward for equities," they wrote. "The underlying AI cycle remains broadly intact, with demand for compute and rapid ongoing advances supporting another year of elevated investment activity."
